After the Storm

By Ada Lovelace

The first rescue boats reached the riverside before sunrise, bringing warm blankets to the families waiting there.

We could see the lights coming through the rain.

What happened

Water covered the lower road, so crews moved supplies to the school gym.

  • Crews opened the north shelter.
  • Neighbors brought food.
    • Fresh water arrived at noon.
